world.title: Bangladesh Unrest: Humayun Kabir's House Targeted As Fresh Violence Erupts
world.summary: Bangladesh is experiencing renewed political unrest, with protests erupting over Sheikh Hasina's planned return. Muhammad Yunus's ancestral home and Grameen Bank properties have been targeted amid the violence. On Thursday night, unidentified individuals attacked these locations, escalating tensions in the country. The situation remains volatile as protests continue, reflecting deep divisions within the political landscape of Bangladesh.

world.title: Iran Refuses Nuclear Inspections as U.S. Military Threats Mount
world.summary: Iran has reiterated its refusal to allow unrestricted access to its nuclear sites for UN inspectors, citing ongoing U.S. military threats. This decision hampers the International Atomic Energy Agency's ability to verify Iran's nuclear materials. A senior Iranian official emphasized that the country will not accept conditions that could lead to military action against it.

business.title: India's forex reserves fall to over three month low of $705 billion
business.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves decreased by over $14 billion to $705.3 billion as of November 13, marking a three-month low, according to the Reserve Bank of India. The decline was attributed to a fall in the value of foreign currency holdings by $7.8 billion and gold holdings by $6.1 billion week-on-week.

business.title: Core sector output growth accelerates to 10.9% in October from 8.2% in September
business.summary: India's core sector output growth accelerated to 10.9% in October, up from 8.2% in September. Iron ore contributed significantly with a 26.4% increase, alongside strong performances in coal and electricity. Conversely, natural gas, crude oil, and fertilizers reported negative growth. The cumulative growth rate for the index from April to October 2026 was recorded at 6%.

business.title: Stock Market Close: Sensex rises for 2nd day, gains 898 pts; Nifty at 25,801; bank shares lead rally
business.summary: The Sensex increased by 898 points, closing higher for the second consecutive day, while the Nifty reached 25,801. In broader markets, the Nifty MidCap 100 rose by 0.66%, but the Nifty SmallCap 100 declined by 0.13%. Bank shares led the rally, contributing significantly to the overall market gains observed on Friday.

technology.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro could move into India’s ultra-premium smartphone segment: Expected price, features
technology.summary: Xiaomi's upcoming Xiaomi 18 Pro is expected to launch in India with a price range of ₹1.6 lakh to ₹1.7 lakh, placing it in the ultra-premium smartphone segment. This information was shared by tipster Yogesh Brar. Additionally, Xiaomi has teased the standard Xiaomi 18 in China and has begun accepting pre-orders ahead of its official launch.

technology.title: GTA 6 sold nearly 25 million copies on day one, crushing every launch record in sight
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI sold approximately 24.6 million digital copies on its launch day, 19 November 2026, generating an estimated $2.36 billion in revenue, according to Sensor Tower. PlayStation 5 accounted for 75% of the sales. The game's performance set new records for video game launches. Take-Two Interactive has not yet provided official sales figures.

sports.title: How South Africa plan to manage expectations
sports.summary: South Africa's squad for the upcoming Test series against Bangladesh will see only three players participating in the subsequent white-ball series. The three ODIs and three T20Is are viewed as unnecessary additions to the schedule. This decision aims to manage expectations and focus on the Test format, with a clear distinction between the two types of cricket.

sports.title: India blind cricket team threatens Pakistan boycott after Asia Cup title row
sports.summary: India's blind cricket team has threatened to boycott future matches against Pakistan following the controversial awarding of the Men's Asia Cup title to Pakistan, despite the final being washed out. The Cricket Association for the Blind in India (CABI) has challenged this decision, claiming it resulted from a misinterpretation of the playing conditions governing the tournament.

sports.title: Spain to face France in Nations League quarter-finals
sports.summary: Spain will compete against France in the quarter-finals of the Nations League. The match is part of a series of exciting games scheduled for next year. Fans are encouraged to engage respectfully with contributors and fellow supporters. Community guidelines emphasize the importance of maintaining a positive environment, explicitly prohibiting trolling or negative interactions with rival sites.

health.title: Winter heart health: Cardiologist explains why cold mornings increase heart attack risk and what precautions you should take
health.summary: Cold mornings in winter can elevate the risk of heart-related emergencies, according to a cardiologist. Lower temperatures may impact blood pressure, heart rate, and circulation, particularly affecting those with pre-existing heart conditions. To mitigate risks, individuals are advised to take precautions such as dressing warmly, avoiding sudden exertion, and monitoring their health closely during colder months.

health.title: ESMO 2026: Advancing Lung Cancer Prevention with Laura Mezquita
health.summary: Laura Mezquita, an oncologist specializing in thoracic oncology, reflects on her initial attraction to the field, influenced by a mentor who reshaped her understanding of lung cancer. Her research focus has evolved over time, emphasizing advancements in lung cancer prevention. Mezquita's experiences highlight the importance of mentorship in shaping medical careers and improving patient outcomes in oncology.

health.title: How wireless ECG patch can transform heart rhythm monitoring
health.summary: A wireless ECG patch, developed by Australian start-up Lubdub from research at RMIT University, monitors heart rhythms continuously for up to 14 days. This wearable device provides doctors with detailed data comparable to medical-grade electrocardiogram (ECG) Holter monitors. Patients prescribed Holter monitors can use this prototype for effective heart rhythm tracking and management.

science.title: Astronomers Observe a Huge Puffy Star Merge with Smaller Companion
science.summary: Astronomers have observed a massive dying star, seven times the mass and 18,000 times the brightness of the sun, merging with a smaller companion in a unique stellar event. This merger occurred in a binary system, where the larger star expanded into a puffy supergiant during its death, ultimately engulfing and combining with the smaller star.

science.title: Indentation-induced polar domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave semiconductor EuTe4
science.summary: Researchers demonstrated mechanically induced polar-domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave semiconductor EuTe₄ at room temperature. Using local indentation with a needle, they achieved write/erase-like changes in polarisation domains. Polarised-light microscopy and second-harmonic-generation measurements revealed in-plane polarisation domains with approximately 90° configurations. This study highlights a novel approach for domain engineering in conducting materials, advancing polarisation-based electronics.

science.title: Preceding meteorological conditions and machine-learning identification of salinity anomalies in the Yangtze Estuary
science.summary: This study investigates salinity anomalies in the Yangtze Estuary, using daily observations and ERA5 reanalysis from 2021 to 2024. It identifies seasonal variability and antecedent meteorological conditions linked to these anomalies. Machine-learning models, including XGBoost and TabPFN, were developed for retrospective identification, revealing key factors like precipitation and temperature that influence anomaly probabilities, enhancing understanding of estuarine salinity dynamics.

entertainment.title: 'Salman Khan se bachne ke liye’: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan's ex-bodyguard recalls tense encounter with 'Maatrubhumi' actor, says he quit within two days
entertainment.summary: Ketan Karande, an actor and bodybuilder, revealed on a podcast that he briefly worked as Aishwarya Rai Bachchan’s bodyguard, primarily to protect her from Salman Khan. He recounted a tense encounter with Khan that prompted him to resign within two days. Karande's comments have sparked interest and discussion regarding the dynamics between the actors involved.

entertainment.title: From Sequins To Classic Whites: Breaking Down Kavya Maran, Anirudh Ravichander's Pre-Wedding Looks
entertainment.summary: Kavya Maran and Anirudh Ravichander got married on November 11, celebrating with family and friends. Their pre-wedding looks featured a mix of styles, including striking sequinned outfits and classic white attire. The couple's fashion choices highlighted their personalities and set the tone for their wedding festivities, marking the beginning of their new life together.

entertainment.title: Pratap Movie Review: Tedious Prison Drama
entertainment.summary: Amit Sadh stars as a disgraced encounter cop in "Pratap," a film written and directed by Sachin Saraf. Despite Sadh's committed performance, the storytelling is criticized for being tedious and predictable, leading to a lack of engagement. The film's narrative struggles to captivate audiences, resulting in a prison drama that fails to deliver a compelling experience.
